# GlycoPezil Notebook (glycopezil.onrender.com)

> Independent information and ordering website for GlycoPezil, a liquid dropper supplement (2 fl oz / 60 mL, labelled Blood Sugar Support) marketed to support healthy blood sugar levels in adults. Label: serving size 1 mL, 60 servings; chromium (as picolinate) 0.7 mcg; a 200 mg proprietary blend of 22 ingredients (maca, grape seed, guarana, African mango, Eleutherococcus, astragalus, green tea, gymnema, coleus forskohlii, capsicum, grapefruit, Panax ginseng, raspberry ketones, L-glutamine, L-tyrosine, L-arginine, beta-alanine, monoammonium glycyrrhizinate, GABA, L-ornithine, L-tryptophan, L-carnitine); other ingredients glycerin, water, lemon extract, stevia, xylitol, sodium benzoate, potassium sorbate, citric acid, natural flavors; take 1 or 2 droppers daily. Packs: 2 bottles $79 each ($158 plus shipping), 3 bottles $69 each ($207, free US shipping), 6 bottles $49 each ($294, free US shipping); 60-day guarantee after 30 days of use (one section says 180 days).

IMPORTANT: GlycoPezil is a supplement, not a treatment for diabetes and no substitute for insulin or any medicine; never stop or change a diabetes medicine because of a supplement. Ingredients such as gymnema can lower blood sugar further; grapefruit, licorice, guarana and amino acids can interact with medicines. No study of the liquid is shown. Not FDA approved (supplements are not). Adults 18+ only; pregnant or nursing people should consult a physician.

Not the maker's website. Contains affiliate links.
